limits: Exact tested binary copied to production without rebuild.
Sequential three-trial arms; not thermally equalized or a causal matched Maya comparison.
Native prefill differs from external SSE TTFT/decode; fresh actual input is about6.3K, not8K DeepSeek tokens.
Near31.5K marker/history checks are narrow functional tests, not general long-context quality or full32K output validation.
Both GPUs use layer groups, not trueTP2.
Host self-access is not a remote-peer test.

Vision inference is untested; native default vision-tower loading is retained, and DSH advertises text only. Unused quant formats, approximate skipping, slot persistence and larger contexts are not activated.
Initial S functional harness used the wrong token-count route and failed404 after valid timings; context was completed in s-check without replacing those timings.
Broader GPU0 Q2_K/Q3_K mixed-expert bit-equality diagnostic failed; those formats are not used by either active pack. No tolerance was relaxed.
